notes.title: Early Access and the Future!
notes.content:
Thank you for playing DIMENSION REIGN!


About Early Access
We released Dimension Reign in Early Access in March 2020. At that time, we planned to stay in Early Access for around a year, depending on community feedback. As of now, we have decided to extend our Early Access period.

Over the past 12 months, Dimension Reign has received high praise from the player base. In order to meet your expectations, we know that we need to improve the balancing and the amount of content.

We have therefore not set a date for when our Early Access period will end.

Future Updates
Up until now, game updates have been infrequent. This meant that there was little opportunity to improve the game based on player feedback.

In response to this, the development team has decided to change the policy. After today's update, we will be rebalancing the game every two weeks. We will continue to improve the game by quickly incorporating your feedback.

We have also created an official Discord. Please join us, provide your feedback, and help us make Dimension Reign better!

Dimension Reign Official Discord
https://discord.gg/nTmrq4rUMU


Finally...
We'd like to announce that we are working on a new dungeon in parallel with balance adjustments. It'll take a while longer to deliver, but stay tuned for it!

notes.title: English Localization Improvement Update
notes.content:
We're happy to say that some much-needed improvements for the English localization have been completed, and new text is now available in-game.

The text was not completely rewritten from the original Japanese, but the entirety of the English text has been edited. Of the 1,700 lines in the main localization document, 1,500 have been changed.

Mechanics
A couple of mechanic names have changed to make their effects easier to understand or to avoid similarly sounding terms:
"DEF Piercing" is now "Impale".
"Counter Null" is now "Counter Bypass".
"Lose" is now "Suffer".
"Escape Rate" is now "Escape chance".
"Status Effect Null" is now "Immunity".


Key Terms
Edge's job "Plunderer" is now "Grave Robber".
When a positive status is added (to players or enemies), the word "gain" is used. For example, "When killed: Adjacent enemies gain [Immunity 1]."
When a negative status is added (to players or enemies), the word "inflict" is used. For example, "[If MP is 100%] When turn begins: Inflict [Poison 1] on a random enemy three times."
When a weapon has a trait added, the word "apply" is used. For example, "When using a [Thrown] weapon: Apply [Impale]."

Items
Many items have had complete name changes to sound more badass or to describe their accompanying artwork.
"Prickly Necklace" is now "Spiked Collar".
"Multilayer Rings" is now "Mortal Coil".
"Offering of Water" is now "Water of the Old Gods".

A lot of the work was focused on consistency. A couple of skills, relics, or items may now display their text descriptions differently, but across the entire game, objects which are the same should be more consistent with each other.

If you have any feedback about the English changes, please feel free to let us know on the Steam Discussions forums or join us on the DIMENSION REIGN Discord: https://discord.gg/nTmrq4rUMU

Our work is far from over, and by the end of 2020, we hope to improve both the Spanish and Chinese localisations. Early next year, we'll also begin rolling out a couple of new languages. Please look forward to those!

Traverse new dungeons and reach the Beast King.

Features

 A dungeon structure divided into five stages
 Deep Ruins with a reasonable risk in exchange for a large number of high rare relics
 A vicious mid-boss you'll need to prepare yourself to take on
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/211c192300f0eb550390c2c8bd9d80c0bf7fb7a0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/939c275616f99b67b8f814cd250a965c05267034.png


The Tarot of the Reaper
A new resource alongside the Gold Dimension Stone, the Tarot of the Death will be available.
Spending Tarot will replace job ability choices and the contents of the treasure chest. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/8fb639812402a73c29199f0fd5b41b23a80ee7f4.png

New Content

We've added a lot more content in addition to the above.

 Ninja Rogue and Knoichi Witch Job Rank Open
 More than 20 additional job abilities in total, mainly for the Ninja Rogue and Knoichi Witch.
 24 New Relics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/fdc5c41c419a29b9b0503e9b1b168e90cb14ee16.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/851c40bb788bb65c21ce1562895ea60b4911a4b4.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/2a522588ce1c8694ee796443106bfe35f5e0396d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/9bcb79f71a9ece1ad8356da91843b7453ddbb17e.png

The new abilities will give you even more scope to build!

UI and UX improvements

We're also working on other improvements to make the game better.

 Supports 4K resolution
 Added the ability to cancel choices and close the screen by right-clicking.
 Added a unique character art for each job type.
 Added background illustrations to the Shop and Camp
 Improved some unclear effect description
 Added tooltips.
 Added Sound Effects for level up and winning a battle.
 Added a feature to speed up the action when you successfully perform a break chain in battle.
 Improved the design of the icons that appear during battles.
 Design of the treasure chest according to the rarity of its contents.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/770e26bbca29bbd77f29ee5ecef609f85dd6f02f.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/966513d7dbed82bfa0cf6f0a6d613d83c272812e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/16644163ae70e7fb98317b232f0a53b35568f2ab.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/447919c0278c565dd1a666e7b8d23ecef5e15199.png


More updates

Balancing
Ninja Rogue

 Adjustment for Job Abilities
 Looting: Adjust level-up increase in stats

Samurai Vampire

 Adjustment for Job Abilities
 Kengo: Change in Unlock Method
 Kengo: Adjusted stats on level-up
 Kengo: Initial equipment changed to special weapon

Knoichi Witch

 Battle Witch: Change in Unlock Method

Relic

 Rarities and abilities of some Relics have been adjusted.

Battle

 Adjusted the percentage of rewards that appear when you win a battle

Treasure

 Adjusting the percentage of rewards earned


Bug fix

 Corrected typos and omissions in the text.
 Fixed an issue where there were weapons and job abilities with different effects under the same name.
 Corrected caption when the effect is activated in battle.
 Fixed an issue where a perfect kill could trigger the effect that deals damage at the start of an Enemy Pahse.
 Fixed an enemy skill that was not working properly

notes.title: [Announcement] DimensionReign Summer Update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Dimension Reign!

The development team would like to remind everyone of an upcoming update! 
This is our biggest update since EA's release in March. Give us your feedback in the community!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1162480

Here's a few of the updates we've picked out for you!

 A new Type is here! 
A new Type of Ninja Rogue, Setsuna is added. 
The concept of the new Type is "speed", like speed chess.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/edf89d555c4ed623f2ee321208fc5d285acbefae.png

 Renewed Dungeon! 
Previous dungeon has had a tendency to make the play experience monotonous in the late game when you've completed your build. To solve this, we've redesigned the dungeon structure. Step through the five newly divided stages.

The dungeon has undergone various other improvements as well.

Deep Ruins
Deep Ruins has become a more high-risk, high-reward area. It's an attractive area, but you'll also encounter reasonable dangers.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/2f27bc29a2606a7117303dcb4bd1b7dd877b7479.png

New Boss Enemy
In the middle of the game, a new boss enemy will stand in your way.
Get ready and prepare for this dengerous boss.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/939c275616f99b67b8f814cd250a965c05267034.png

New Feature: Tarot of the Death
A new item, the Tarot of the Death, is now available. 
The Tarot of the Death will allow you to create more powerful builds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36744604/8fb639812402a73c29199f0fd5b41b23a80ee7f4.png

Lots of other improvements and additional content
-  Job Rank limit increased for Ninja Rogue and Knoichi Witch
- New relics added.
- Balance adjustment
- Support for 4K resolution
- Added feature to let Right-click to cancel

We have many other updates planned, including balance adjustments and usability improvements.Stay tuned for the release!
(Updates are subject to change.)
